name: review-panel
description: A library of ten read-only persona reviewer subagents (grumpy senior, paranoid SRE, fact-checker, DX advocate, threat modeller, goal auditor, outsider, contract keeper, cost hawk, noise filter) and an /assemble-panel skill that picks the right panel for a plan, spec, diff or decision, briefs and dispatches it in parallel, and filters the reports into one triage.
